title: citrus × aurantiifolia
intro: Citrus × aurantiifolia, commonly known as lime or calamansi, is a hybrid citrus plant that is widely cultivated for its fruit and leaves. The health benefits of lime include aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of lime include its use in traditional medicine for its antiseptic and astringent properties, as well as its ability to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of lime include limonene, limonin, and naringin, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
